title: CALM Backstage
description: CALM architectures in Backstage: the Backstage app and its CALM plugins, the CALM Hub that holds the architectures, the OCI registry that holds the template bundles, Gitea for each service's repository, and a local Kubernetes cluster where Flux deploys the services. Everything runs on one developer machine; there is no authentication between the parts (local development only).

metadata.scope: local development, as run by yarn hub:up, yarn k8s:up and yarn start

nodes.name: Developer
nodes.description: Browses architectures, creates a service from a pattern, and upgrades it.

nodes.name: Backstage app
nodes.description: The Backstage frontend with the calm plugin: architecture and pattern cards, the Template Explorer, the placeholders form field, Upgrade and Open the running app.

nodes.name: Backstage backend
nodes.description: The one Backstage backend process. It runs the CALM plugins below, the catalog and the scaffolder, and runs kubectl, minikube and git as local processes. The reservation of a service's working copy lives in this process, so it assumes one backend.

nodes.name: CALM catalog module
nodes.description: catalog-backend-module-calm: an entity provider that turns the Hub's architectures, patterns, controls and the registry's bundles into catalog entities, and one Template per pattern.

nodes.name: CALM scaffolder module
nodes.description: scaffolder-backend-module-calm: the calm:* actions. generate, fill, validate, store in the Hub, render a bundle, publish, build the image, deploy through Git and Flux, record the deployment, upgrade.

nodes.name: CALM backend plugin
nodes.description: calm-backend: the routes the cards call (architecture, pattern, upgrades, bundles) and the app proxy that opens a deployed service from Backstage.

nodes.name: CALM node library
nodes.description: calm-node: runs the published @finos/calm-cli (generate, validate, template), pushes and pulls template bundles as OCI artifacts, and runs kubectl, minikube and git against the one configured cluster.

nodes.name: Local Docker
nodes.description: The Docker Compose project in hub/: the Hub, its MongoDB, the bundle registry and Gitea. Every port is published on 127.0.0.1 only (Gitea can be opened to the network with GITEA_BIND).

nodes.name: CALM Hub
nodes.description: finos/calm-hub in no-auth mode. Holds the patterns, the controls, and the only copy of each service's architecture. Versions cannot change or be deleted. Deployments are recorded on an architecture version as decorators.

service-dependency.description: Each service's runtime dependencies are mapped as CALM nodes and relationships in the Hub, and its deployments are recorded against the architecture version

config.name: Service Dependency Control
config.description: The Hub holds each service's architecture as nodes and relationships, and a deployment is recorded on the architecture version it ran. The Backstage catalog shows both

nodes.name: Hub MongoDB
nodes.description: MongoDB behind the CALM Hub, in a Docker volume.

nodes.name: Bundle registry
nodes.description: An OCI registry (registry:2) holding the template bundles as calm-bundles/<name>:<version>. A published version is immutable. Each bundle is published from a commit of the calm-templates/bundles repository in Gitea.

artifact-provenance.description: A bundle is published from a known Git commit, and a service records the bundle reference and digest it was rendered with

config.name: Software Artifact Provenance
config.description: A bundle is published from a Gitea commit as an immutable OCI version, and a service's catalog-info records the bundle reference and digest it was rendered with

nodes.name: Gitea
nodes.description: Stands in for GitHub: calm-templates/bundles holds the bundle sources and calm-services/<name> holds one repository per service, including its deploy overlay. Flux reads it from inside the cluster.

version-control.description: A service's code, its architecture reference and its deployment configuration are kept in its own Git repository

config.name: Version Control
config.description: The code, the architecture annotations and the deploy overlay of each service are in its own Git repository, and Flux deploys the commit it names

nodes.name: Local Kubernetes cluster
nodes.description: A minikube profile (calm-backstage) with Calico, so NetworkPolicies are enforced. Backstage reaches it only through its own kubeconfig, never the developer's default one.

infrastructure-dependencies.description: The compute, network and storage a service needs are generated from its architecture (workloads, Services, NetworkPolicies) and kept with its code

config.name: Infrastructure Dependencies
config.description: k8s-deploy renders the workloads, Services and NetworkPolicies from the service's architecture, and they are committed with the service

nodes.name: Flux source-controller
nodes.description: Clones each service repository from Gitea (http://host.minikube.internal:3300).

nodes.name: Flux kustomize-controller
nodes.description: Applies each service's deploy overlay as that service's own service account. A Kustomization without one runs as the permissionless flux-system/default.

nodes.name: cert-manager
nodes.description: Issues the per-service certificates (self-signed CA) for the TLS sidecar of k8s-deploy 1.3.x.

nodes.name: Deployed service
nodes.description: A service created from a pattern, in its own namespace (calm-<name>) with Pod Security baseline: its workloads, an nginx TLS sidecar and the NetworkPolicies rendered from its architecture. There can be many.
